info.name: Edeviser – Agentic Platform Tables
info.description:
CRUD requests for the 9 new tables introduced by migration 20260831000002_agentic_platform_tables.sql.

All PostgREST endpoints:
  {{base_url}}/rest/v1/<table>
  apikey: {{anon_key}}
  Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}

Folders: agent_conversations, agent_messages, agent_tasks, agent_feedback,
agent_evaluations, learning_interventions, intervention_outcomes,
learning_state_events, student_support_states.

item.name: agent_conversations
item.description: Conversation threads between a user and an AI specialist.

request.description: Fetch the 20 most recent conversations for the authenticated actor (RLS-scoped).
Create a new conversation. Returns the created row.
Fetch a single conversation by its UUID.
Update the title of a conversation (actor owns it via RLS).
Delete the conversation created in this test run.

item.name: agent_messages
item.description: Individual messages within a conversation thread.

request.description: List all messages for a given conversation (RLS-scoped).
Insert a user message into a conversation.
Note: messages are append-only in production. This endpoint is provided for admin correction flows only.

item.name: agent_tasks
item.description: Actionable tasks assigned to users by the agent.

item.name: agent_feedback
item.description: User ratings and qualitative feedback on agent responses.

item.name: agent_evaluations
item.description: Automated quality evaluation scores for agent runs (task 7.4 harness sink).

request.description: Insert an evaluation record from the task 7.4 eval harness. Typically service-role only.

item.name: learning_interventions
item.description: Structured interventions proposed or active for a student.

item.name: intervention_outcomes
item.description: Measured outcome metrics linked to a learning intervention.

item.name: learning_state_events
item.description: Immutable event stream of student digital-twin state changes.

request.description: Append-only: events are immutable once written. No UPDATE or DELETE policies exist.
This table has no UPDATE policy. Expect 403 Forbidden — verifies immutability.
This table has no DELETE policy. Expect 403 Forbidden — verifies immutability.

item.name: student_support_states
item.description: Current support tier for a student (none / watch / supported / escalated).

request.description: student_id has a UNIQUE constraint — only one row per student. Use PATCH to update.

item.name: agent_tool_calls (view)
item.description: Security-invoker view over agent_tool_attempts — read-only, no DML.

request.description: Read-only security_invoker view. Returns rows from agent_tool_attempts scoped by caller's RLS.
